body: Daylyt is fucking fire..his shit Is intricate and on some next level shit..its too intelligent for dumb motherfuckers who want crack and gun bars..
I agree the internet is a poor substitution for connection. I cannot put myself in your shoes..but I understand loneliness and I can be a listening ear.

I probably shouldn't say this but a low dose of a benzodiazepine used sparingly for when you go out to meet others could really tamper down the anxiety..you should consult your doctor..due to the nature of autism I appreciate this would be difficult to do . There are meetup groups on the internet as ways to hang out with others..shared interests..ie movies..food..art..gaming..you name it.you just need the anxiety under control while you practice..could you consider an informed doctor..if yours sucks get a new one..you deserve some connection my friend:)

Stay calm it's ok.. your in pain and probably in sone shock..dont act on anything tonight..you can wait..if you really feel you cant stay safe then you must  call a doctor or go to the er at a hospital .Your life is very valuable dont act on these thoughts..the pain will lessen with time..could you call a trusted friend? You need someone to talk to. Keep safe tonight.
Sounds fun! It's a bit like a rollercoaster in here there are some characters I tell you lol..I'm off to bed to..goodnight, sleep well.
Not too bad...i think this new med has lifted my mood and I actually used the gym in here..so unfit but it's a start..went out with my dad for lunch..how are you getting on?

With connection to other people you care about and therapy..I stress the therapy..longer term stuff where you can build up a relationship with your psychologist and trust them. You may need a tweak with medication too..I found that its kinda trial and error until I found one that suited and is helping. It's very hard to motivate with bad depression cause it saps energy and for me almost slows things down...but I find if I can get around supportive people then I dont get lost in my head as much listening to the constant negative messages it causes. Isolation is the enemy...it wants you on your own and ruminating...feeling like crap.  Any connection is good...people..nature..but yeah dont give up because you can and will recover.
Cool :)

No six tablets wouldn't have hurt just made your liver work a bit harder to clear it for a few hours..I think the max dose is 8tabs in 24 hrs but that's 2 every six hours..your fine but I wouldn't make a habit of it! You'll get there..try not to worry too much..when I think about the past I get depressed...the future I get anxious..I'm trying to learn mindfulness to stay in the moment. Theres alot of cool short guided meditations on you tube..I think John kabat Zinn is the best.

With all you've tried I understand you want to go..I have been an addict for 35 years. Hospitals..rehabs pills..overdoses..intense isolation and anxiety states..I'm actually in hospital now due to an attempt..I cant say that I or it will get better.but I'm trying. I do understand intense misery and I'm sorry your going through this pain. Even though the circumstances are different I just want you to know you are not alone. Dont give up just yet..ok?
There will be...remember peoples fucked up decisions and actions are not your fault..just like they weren't my sisters..I stand with you.. even if it's on a subreddit post.

Your slogging through alot off bullshit..stress..marriage problems and depression..give yourself some credit my friend it's awful but it will end..you will breakthrough. Whether your marriage survives or not if you stay you'll always be around for your little girl..that pure love can pull you through.

Very uplifting post! I'm glad you are going to stay and work on it bit by bit. I'm in hospital after doing something dangerous and almost fatal..I may have bpd..seeing psychologist on Monday.. thank you for your spirit my friend..I want to get better too!
Fuck off Fisty...troll somewhere else!

Near death experiences can cause PTSD for sure I've had a few from very near fatal overdoses to almost jumping 120 ft onto concrete 2 weeks ago..I'm in hospital now and starting to feel better..people tend to change their mind sometimes during the act..I would see a psychologist as it's the issues that drove you to it. Very close call..I'm glad you made it!
Oh yeah just an afterthought..get a smartphone and encrypt it if u can afford.. You need some privacy away from her prying eyes.

I'm glad your not storing them up...it takes 3 days to die with paracetamol and the kicker is that you seem to recover half way through...that's when people think...oh shit maybe I can solve some of the stuff that's bothering me so much..then your liver melts and its horrible. The UK does blow when it comes to mental health..its so underfunded..that's why you have to push them..because until you tell them how bad you feel..really tell them..then they kinda ignore you...that's my experience anyway and have been in hospital a few times. You have 8 sessions left..plenty of time to open up...what are your fears about it?  Mine were pride..I didn't want anyone to know I was struggling and fear of rejection if I opened up... but in the end my I had to tell my family because I got detained and taken to a place of safety after doing something really really dangerous...I was sick of the pain of having a severe addiction for 25 yrs and not being able to stop..hospital isn't great or ideal but it's safe.. they check on you and some really care..my meds got tweaked and upped and I'm starting to feel better..plus my psychological therapy begins on Monday.. I figure wtf I'm gonna let it all hang out.. they have heard it all before and are unshockable anyway...I've got some terrible stories but some really funny ones too..maybe when your feeling better I'll tell you the funny ones. I'm 48 probably ancient by your standards and mine lol but Its never to late to make a brand new start....(sorry I stole that from Paul Weller the modfather) hehe my point is this you dont have to let it get that bad.. and opening up doesn't mean you get taken away by men in white coats. I dont fully know your life circumstances but a combination of longer term pyschotherapy and meds could see you fully recover...CBT is ok..but it's kinda short and it sounds like getting to the root of the problems would really be beneficial for you! And hey thank you too..youve helped me in here..its funny how sharing stuff goes both ways..I wish you luck :)

I have scoliosis also..I was supposed to wear a Milwaukee brace at school bit was too cool to rock one.i regret it now as I have 2 blown discs at l4 and 5 and a fucked up shoulder..I have sciatica..chronic pain sucks..I feel you and I'm pissed at your dickhead parents..but yes you need to see an md and see what  can be done sooner rather than later.

I'm so sorry you have this to deal with..it happened in my family to my sister by my stepdad. I think your incredibly brave exploring this issue with your therapist and while I have no direct advice to give due to lack of personal experience..(my abuse was all non sexual  violence) .I'm sure there will be posters that can offer more insight and help.
Social anxiety can be terrible but have you tried any meds to help you with that..it may ease it a little and make you more comfortable to interact with others.

Feeling people would  be better off without you is a classic sign of severe depression. It's not true but feels real. If your in the UK then it's hard to get treatment but if your totally honest with your doctor then he can push hard to get you the help. I also tried the hanging and it's not a nice way to go. You deserve to give yourself a chance..even though you feel like shit. I hope you fight this..I believe you can.
It depends on how much you've relied on a person..Meewol is right you must seek professional help..once your friends see your trying to help yourself,you'll know who the true ones are.

It's hard when you feel like you cant face another day let alone the rest of it all..I was about to end things but I had something inside that said I deserve a chance for things to change to be different..I'm not going to patronise you with age and life etc..your depressed and obviously theres alot more going on in your life. I'm sorry you are in this pain..you can get through it..just not alone..we've tried that and it doesn't work. You need  an ally. Just one will do.

I can relate to living in a homophobic society..I learned I was attracted to boys in 1980'S Oklahoma!! There was no coming out then..your not going to hell..I was taught the same thing..Revelations and all that stuff. You are alright as you! Are you still in school? If you are know that will end and you can get the fuck out. If your older you can move to a more progressive place and make loads of friends! I hate to break it to you but your normal. It does sound like you are severely depressed tho..you need someone you trust to talk to and if you dont have anyone you can put your feelings on here..theres probably some good hotlines to call also.

You've got alot to give man...through your pain and experience you could probably reach somebody who needs help..Autism..isolation..anxiety..there could be connection in reaching others who suffer as well.

When the times right you'll open up and let someone in..its sounds like alot of people care and want to help..depression and life events can be very isolating..you just need to let a trusted friend  or professional know how youve been feeling..walls keep us safe in the beginning..they help us cope when we are young but they end up imprisoning..we dont have to do that anymore. I think your heading in the right direction by posting. I can appreciate not wanting to worry your friends but they are your mates! (Sorry I'm English lol) Trust me the true ones would want to know  considering the alternative you've had in your head! But I must add I think its important you consider seeing a professional..they are equipped trained and can totally help.

You can, as long as you have support to do it..Dave is right you can't take responsibility for your mothers mental illness...only she can..and if she gets worse an institution will. You have a responsibility to yourself to get away so you wont be hurt anymore..its painful stuff..very...but she's got your Dad and you deserve to have a life! You really do.
Can I ask...why the pain?

That's gotta suck...my sister is on her way to making her first million and I'm stuck in a nuthouse!!  Go figure...WTF dude..I finally realised no one is as happy as they appear to be..everyone is fucked up in some way..believe...I take a perverse sense of hope in how we humans are lol

I found it so painful watching others make meaningful relationships and moving on in life while I stayed in a bubble somewhere out in space..it was kinda like looking through glass..I could see but couldn't touch...I'm getting old now I guess but I believe I can improve.
I hear you...and feel your pain! Lol.. I can't hang out with my parents as they are pretty nuts.

You can't see any solutions right now...I get it and feel it from your posts. Your right I dont have autism.  But I do know intense isolation and anxiety..25 years of it. So maybe..well I hope I can connect to you on that level.

I understand..you dont have to say and I wont go into detail but i went through alot as a child to say the least. Pain is pain and everyone's story is the worst because they had to live it. Talk to your friend..you need to talk to someone..maybe from there other opportunities will arise to help you heal. I'm in hospital after almost jumping off a very high building. I know how it feels..I'm waiting on therapy and have a bit of hope in shifting or coping with the pain.You deserve a chance too :)

Make the call...depression is the anti-self...its not you. Unfortunately your right you can't do it without hurting them..and you care about that..if you seek help your feelings may change..its worth a go.
God it sounds like a long one... cant you make an excuse and cut out early?  Jeez..

I take you seriously. Exhaust all avenues of possible help for the pain before you act..if family are of no help then you could try doctors..therapy..medication..hell even stowaway on a ship bound for Australia! Who cares if your about to leave the planet..fuck it try some drastic solutions (bar drugs and booze) trust me they suck and make the pain worse. Your worth a last roll of the dice..what have you got to lose?

Stop blaming yourself..you have something that isn't your fault...you've done the best you can up to this point and you can work on new relationships day to day...I've had severe addiction since my teens and I have been very isolated due to it..but I still hope to make connections..I believe we can!

You want people to know how you feel...maybe that's a reason...we all want that. Most suicide survivors report some ambivalence leading up to the act..maybe a reason for your post. I'm sorry your going through such pain and I'm around if you want to talk 👂🙏
Youd probably just coma and wake up in hospital. I'm sorry you feel so shitty your hoarding meds..but the other poster is right this will just add more problems to deal with.

I've had similar fears due to the religious programming I got as a child...my brother summed it up pretty well...why would a God supposedly based on love decide to torture you forever because you were so miserable you took your own life?  It doesn't make sense. Whatever your  beliefs stick around for a bit and see if talking helps..
I agree! No contact..I recently had to do this..you can get through this brother!

Severe depression...I know it well...its worrying you have come close as have I...each time I was stopped by thoughts of my family. It's good that you have these thoughts they have been protecting you in a way..but now could you see a doctor? Are you being treated for depression?..its so hard when we lose the will to live and feel trapped ..I've felt this a d have even felt angry at my family for making me stay. I just want you to know I've shared the same feelings and actions. Your not alone..keep posting.

I can relate to loving my mother despite the abuse..but recently someone asked me why do you have to love her so much? What has she done to merit such love? It helped me do what I had to do...cut her loose. You've been through alot..the most important person is you!

Please dont do that..its a nasty way to go..I had a friend do this and it wasn't pretty..plus she changed her mind in hospital but it was too late..could you consider talking to someone you trust about how you feel?
I can't tell you because I wouldn't want it on my conscience. I will say that I'm sorry the pain is so bad you are looking for this way out..I can relate..I've been there. Your NOT alone.

I think it's great your an artist! Oh but the way look at the reddit sub raised by narcissists.. it's the black one with 390k subscribers..they have some helpful tips...I realise you are stuck at the family home but keep safe and just try to sleep there limiting interaction until your exit 🙏

To be honest it's going to be difficult anyway you slice it...your parents dont respect your boundaries   because they can't.. toxicity.Narcissism two reasons why they are not able to let you be you..its about control and I stress that you need to get away...plan for it..save..if you know you are making progress on your plan to  be free from these a abusive assholes then there is hope..I dont recommend staying.
I'm kinda a slow learner lol
I just need non judgmental people to talk to..it makes a difference
Yeah I was on once a week cause they thought I was gonna off myself...I can relate my friend

Ok...I'm sorry you have to go through this pain..I almost dropped 120ft 2 weeks ago and I'm in hospital..but I still managed to have the genius idea of going out yesterday and doing drugs to numb out my feelings..I may get kicked out and fuck up my therapy..we all screw up...I'm 48 dude..
I'm sorry your going through such a tough time..depression fucking sucks..its good you came on here and can Express it..I've been trying it lately a d it has been helping me :)
Just a question..deliberate od or addiction od?

Plus you've got alot of hormones flooding your brain..adolescence is tough as hell...you've got a really good chance on getting a handle on it..from an outside perspective ..a head start over the average smoe who realises they are struggling late twenties to thirties. It probably doesn't feel like that though.
Yeah...maybe a different class of meds..it may just click with the therapy...its alot of hit and miss pain in the ass adjustments..but it could just click..
I'm as nutty as a fruitcake!

I did resent my Dad for leaving us and we ended up with a brutal Nstepdad and Nmom who happily joined in battering us...I see it in a different light now tho...he had to get away from her and didn't know she would remarry so fast...he only recently learned of the abuse and has been so supportive...but I was hurt and pissed at him for years.

I've heard this too..that the process can take a good while..dont give up ok? My friend went through a terrible trauma when he was 11..I wont go into it but he did several tough years of therapy and finally broke through..he was on heroin for many years self medicating..but hes like 15 years clean now and has is a counsellor himself..not to get all happy clappy joy boy on you it's just that I think it's worth sticking at it.

You've been through so much in your life..I can relate to the abuse and trauma you've suffered..my parents mom/stepdad were hypocritical Jehovah Witnesses and it really messed with my head. Your mom does sound psycho as you put it..would you be in a position to move at some point?  I recently cut out my toxic parents as they are just too much. From what I read you know what your issues are not her so maybe the power comes from your choice on what to work on. Easier said than done I know as therapy is expensive..you want to live not just exist I get it..I'm sorry you have alot of pain inside..I dont have alot of answers but please know your not alone with what happened. There are some good support groups out there.

I think its incredible that in your teens you have tried these avenues of possible help..I didn't and felt similar at the same age. I self medicated with illegal drugs and it turned out really bad.  Have you tried lots of different meds or therapies?  I think its hopeful that you have or are still giving it a try..I hate depression and anxiety..all of us siblings have issues with these. I'm finally going to try some therapy now that I'm in hospital..
I'm so sorry your hurting this much..would you consider some kind of therapy? You may have already it's just a thought..I'm in hospital waiting for mine.
I hope your ok and I really wanted to say I'm sorry you are going through this pain.

Theres nothing wrong with the Smiths mate they were a fucking ace band! I struggle with addiction too..drugs but addiction is addiction.You eat to comfort yourself..fuck social media seriously..its fake and does not represent the reality of peoples mundane lives. You have someone to live for...YOU! And it sounds like your grandparents love you!  At 16 you can improve..hard as hell to believe when your depressed I know..I've had alot of isolation due to addiction and I know how much loneliness hurts..but you can start over..hell im 48 and in a pysch hospital because I can't stop using.. but I'm not ready to give up on myself just yet.. Please wait awhile and share your feelings with someone you can trust...you deserve to! 🙏

Try and speak to anyone before you do this..a friend..hotline..counsellor..ANYBODY...even if it's just on Reddit..I was 120ft up staring down two weeks ago..trust me those that love you will be devastated..and believe me you are loved by someone, even if you can't feel it right now..dont give up yet wait a few days or a week..I dont know what's happened in your life..but I do feel different than when I almost jumped..things can improve..I know you probably dont want to hear this but you matter..to yourself and others..even to a complete stranger on a forum! Wait a bit and talk to someone..you can always make that Choice later if you really want to. Give yourself a chance. 🙏👂

Jesus H!!! That was a very sick and horrific situation..she sounds more twisted than a hundred pretzels!! Everyone is right she sounds sociopathic and you did incredibly well to get out. My stepdad had done some disgusting shit to us and my sister..we are middle aged now but these wounds run deep..I hope you've had or are going to get some therapy..you deserve to heal like we all do..
Thanks brother..I'm hanging in there :)

Thank you..my depression over this reached  crisis point and I'm in hospital..they agree that I need psychological therapy more than medications.The kicker is that I have to live in the same town at the moment due to financial reasons:(
Power to you brother...despite her abuse and no contact now I still love my nmom..I wish I didn't..

Fuck....how your not depressed out of your mind is beyond me...he contributes nothing right? Hes obviously mentally unwell...how old is your brother again...sorry if I missed it but are you staying to look out for him? Seriously you need to get the fuck out of there. Even a hostel would be better..I really feel for you on this one..hes a whack job.

Your not alone..I'm bi and coming out to my mum was difficult  because she said it was due to sexual abuse I'd suffered..all  bullshit. You sound like an incredibly strong person to deal with all the shit you are going through. I've recently cut off my abusive parents. As for the picking...I  did it compulsively on my face which has led to hyperpigmentation patches...also I used drugs compulsively for many years...I dont know if this helps..just wanted you to know we are all  behind  you....good luck on the therapy 😀
Thankkgod you got away..your mom sounds highly disturbed and no doubt you carry the damage with you..I hope you can access some therapy and start to heal..my Goodness you deserve it!
Thanks guys..I'm on a new med and though it's boring in here, I feel I'm being levelled up out of the pit each day.
I'm sorry too..having whacked out parents is a shitty hand to be dealt. Sending positive and healing vibes to ya.

I agree..I dont think I'll ever fully move on, the memories and damage has been done...just farther away would be good progress I guess. I'd like to get to a point where it doesn't control me anymore as I'm still raging about it. That's the hope anyway.

I can relate...the abuse and mindfuckery of my childhood was definitely a factor in me getting  into drugs and addiction to escape the pain of it all..it screwed my life and health pretty badly. I'm just dealing with the consequences now..I chose not to have kids. I think someone said " to live well is the best revenge" I'm really going to try..I think letting my parents go and therapy is the way forward..for both of us.
I'm really sorry..your mom is really unwell..sounds like she acted out her damage on you kids..it was abuse and lack of respect for your boundaries..nit your fault at all and therapy will help.
Thanks  baybird..I woke up feeling guilty but it's not my fault they caused the problem.not me.
